svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print from the model file (cad/step/picoflow-runner.step), hub down,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with supports under the buckets. 200 mm across, 50 mm tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 525 g and 21 h at 0.4 mm; four perimeters.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 buckets on a 150 mm pitch circle; the jets strike the top of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bucket band, which is 17 mm above the runner's mid-height.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hub: 80 mm across, 50 mm tall, 20 mm bore. Ream the bore to slide

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the shaft. Press four M5 heat-set inserts into the hub top on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 44 mm circle with a soldering iron.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Balance: hang the runner on a rod through the bore; if one side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: always drops, sand the bucket backs on that side lightly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the clamping hub bolts to the hub top with four M5 screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the runner spins on a rod and stops in random places.
